# Challenge solution

Read the [standard](../../../docs/standards/delivery.md) and the context analysis.
Skip for Small changes unless risk justifies it.

Challenge whether the problem/outcome is clear, the baseline is accepted, the
proposal is necessary and a simpler approach preserves behaviour. Consult the
existing Critical Thinking specialist for significant design choices, using a
bounded question rather than delegating the whole implementation.

Record alternatives, trade-offs and unresolved owner decisions in the spec/ADR.
Do not answer your own product questions or treat advice as approval.

Output: focused design challenge, resulting decisions/unknowns and ADR inputs.
